name: Weather
reason: Folks, this week is dry with only 2.0 mm of rain, which keeps the water calm, but highs averaging just 22.8C and a single hot day leave the heat a bit short of what a bloom really wants.
evidence: Average max temperature 22.8C, well below the 30C threshold that favors blooms
Only 1 hot day this week, so there was no sustained heat run
Rain total of 2.0 mm means little flushing or mixing of the water
Early September: warmth is still present, but the season is starting to fade
